use_case_summary: Primary: internal researcher chat assistant to accelerate experiment design and literature summarization. Secondary: document search + reranking across private internal corpus. Needs long-context (>16k) for experiment logs, strict residency for IP, and SSO/KMS. Latency tolerance moderate (200-500ms per chat response), throughput low but unpredictable bursts during experiments.
